versions.changelog: Reworked demand generation to use real 2011 Census ward-level worker counts (Table PCA-TV) as spatial weights across all 198 BBMP wards, replacing the old subdistrict-level average. The real citywide jobs total (SHRUG 2013 Economic Census, 1,940,204) is unchanged — only its spatial distribution is now ward-by-ward. All 198 wards matched a Census weight with zero gaps, confirmed by both a direct data join and a full production run with exact conservation.
